reviewNotes: Held back: the score gives no year for the translation; not provably public domain: "textPublished" must be a year before 1929. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1922, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. Line breaks in the words are worked out from the syllables and punctuation; check them against a hymn book.
